title: Local blur check never fires: BLUR_THRESHOLD=40 on edge variance, but a heavily blurred synthetic document scores ~300 and clear ones 1800-2800 (the score depends on how much text is on the page)
steps_to_reproduce: python tests/run_all.py  (test_backend_blur_detector_flags_blurred_synthetic_documents is marked expectedFailure); or open any data/documents/*_blurry.png and call app.ocr.image_quality on it
notes: Impact: blurry photos are sent to the model and spend free-tier quota instead of being rejected locally. Proposed fix: sharpness ratio in evalkit/blur.py (clear 4.5-5.1, low-res 1.6-1.7, blurred 1.0; threshold 2.0). Cropped images are not detectable by this metric; leave them to the model
